         (@FreeOmegaMeasure.FreeOmegaObservableSemanticOmega MN NI NO) R R

endpoints.type:
@Iter.peutt_iter_unfold
     : forall (E MN : Type -> Type) (NI : TwoLevelMeasure.SemanticMeasure MN)
         (NC : @TwoLevelMeasure.SemanticMeasureCoreLaws MN NI)
         (NO : @TwoLevelMeasure.SemanticOmega MN NI) (I R : Type)
         (step : I -> PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN (I + R)) (i : I),
       @PEutt.peutt E MN (FreeOmegaMeasure.FreeOmega MN)
         (@FreeOmegaMeasure.FreeOmegaObservableSemanticMeasure MN NI NO)
         (@FreeOmegaMeasure.FreeOmegaObservableSemanticMeasureCoreLaws MN NI NC NO)
         (@FreeOmegaMeasure.FreeOmegaMixedMeasure MN)
         (@FreeOmegaMeasure.FreeOmegaObservableSemanticOmega MN NI NO) R R
         (@eq R) (@PTreeDefinition.PTree.iter E MN R I step i)
         (@PTreeDefinition.PTree.bind E MN (I + R) R (step i)
            (fun lr : I + R =>
             match lr with
             | @inl _ _ i' =>
                 {|
                   PTreeDefinition._observe :=
                     @PTreeDefinition.TauF E MN R (PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN R)
                       (@PTreeDefinition.PTree.iter E MN R I step i')
                 |}
             | @inr _ _ r =>
                 {|
                   PTreeDefinition._observe :=
                     @PTreeDefinition.RetF E MN R (PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN R) r
                 |}
             end))

endpoints.name: PTree.API.Generic.peutt_coinduction
endpoints.type:
@PEutt.peutt_coinduction
     : forall (E MN MF : Type -> Type) (FI : TwoLevelMeasure.SemanticMeasure MF)
         (FC : @TwoLevelMeasure.SemanticMeasureCoreLaws MF FI)
         (MX : TwoLevelMeasure.MixedMeasure MN MF) (FO : @TwoLevelMeasure.SemanticOmega MF FI)
         (R1 R2 : Type) (RR : R1 -> R2 -> Prop)
         (sim : PTreeDefinition.ptreeF E MN R1 (PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN R1) ->
                PTreeDefinition.ptreeF E MN R2 (PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN R2) -> Prop),
       (forall (s1 : PTreeDefinition.ptreeF E MN R1 (PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN R1))
          (s2 : PTreeDefinition.ptreeF E MN R2 (PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN R2)),
        sim s1 s2 ->
        @StableHittingRelation.stable_hitting_match MF FI FO
          (PTreeDefinition.ptreeF E MN R1 (PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN R1))
          (PTreeDefinition.ptreeF E MN R2 (PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN R2))
          (UnifiedFrontier.stable_head E MN R1) (UnifiedFrontier.stable_head E MN R2)
          (@PTreeKernel.ptree_primitive_kernel E MN MF FI MX R1)
          (@PTreeKernel.ptree_primitive_kernel E MN MF FI MX R2)
          (@PEutt.ptree_stable_head_rel E MN R1 R2 RR) sim s1 s2) ->
       forall (t1 : PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN R1) (t2 : PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN R2),
       sim (@PTreeDefinition.observe E MN R1 t1) (@PTreeDefinition.observe E MN R2 t2) ->
       @PEutt.peutt E MN MF FI FC MX FO R1 R2 RR t1 t2
endpoints.assumptions: Closed under the global context

     : forall (E MN MF : Type -> Type) (FI : TwoLevelMeasure.SemanticMeasure MF)
         (FC : @TwoLevelMeasure.SemanticMeasureCoreLaws MF FI)
         (MX : TwoLevelMeasure.MixedMeasure MN MF) (FO : @TwoLevelMeasure.SemanticOmega MF FI),
       @TwoLevelMeasure.SemanticOmegaLaws MF FI FO ->
       forall (R1 R2 : Type) (RR : R1 -> R2 -> Prop) (t1 : PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN R1)
         (t2 : PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN R2) (out1 : MF (UnifiedFrontier.stable_head E MN R1))
         (out2 : MF (UnifiedFrontier.stable_head E MN R2)),
       @PEutt.peutt E MN MF FI FC MX FO R1 R2 RR t1 t2 ->
       @PrimitiveStableHitting.stable_hitting MF FI FO
         (PTreeDefinition.ptreeF E MN R1 (PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN R1))
         (UnifiedFrontier.stable_head E MN R1)
         (@PTreeKernel.ptree_primitive_kernel E MN MF FI MX R1)
         (@PTreeDefinition.observe E MN R1 t1) out1 ->
       @PrimitiveStableHitting.stable_hitting MF FI FO
         (PTreeDefinition.ptreeF E MN R2 (PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN R2))
         (UnifiedFrontier.stable_head E MN R2)
         (@PTreeKernel.ptree_primitive_kernel E MN MF FI MX R2)
         (@PTreeDefinition.observe E MN R2 t2) out2 ->
       @TwoLevelMeasure.sem_lift MF FI (UnifiedFrontier.stable_head E MN R1)
         (UnifiedFrontier.stable_head E MN R2)
         (@PEutt.ptree_stable_head_rel E MN R1 R2 RR

endpoints.name: PTree.API.Generic.peutt_iff_hitting
endpoints.type:
@StableHittingComputation.peutt_iff_hitting
     : forall (E MN MF : Type -> Type) (FI : TwoLevelMeasure.SemanticMeasure MF)
         (FC : @TwoLevelMeasure.SemanticMeasureCoreLaws MF FI)
         (MX : TwoLevelMeasure.MixedMeasure MN MF) (FO : @TwoLevelMeasure.SemanticOmega MF FI),
       @TwoLevelMeasure.SemanticMeasureOrderLaws MF FI FO ->
       @TwoLevelMeasure.SemanticOmegaLaws MF FI FO ->
       forall (A B : Type) (RR : A -> B -> Prop) (t : PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN A)
         (u : PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN B),
       @PEutt.peutt E MN MF FI FC MX FO A B RR t u <->
       (exists
          (out1 : MF (UnifiedFrontier.stable_head E MN A)) (out2 : MF
                                                                     (UnifiedFrontier.stable_head E
                                                                      MN B)),
          @PrimitiveStableHitting.stable_hitting MF FI FO
            (PTreeDefinition.ptreeF E MN A (PTreeDefinition.ptree E MN A))
            (UnifiedFrontier.stable_head E MN A)
            (@PTreeKernel.ptree_primitive_kernel E MN MF FI MX A)
